section.title: Frequently asked questions
section.subtitle: Still unsure? Message us on WhatsApp — we reply fast.

q1.a: Most businesses are up and running within the same day. We handle onboarding — you just need your menu and business details ready.

q2.a: We operate on a yearly subscription model. After your first year, you can renew annually or switch plans — no long-term lock-in beyond the current year.

q3.a: Our POS runs natively on Android tablets and phones, with webapp support for iPad and iPhone (native iOS coming soon). We support Sunmi, iMin, and most standard thermal printers and kitchen display setups.

q4.q: Can I stop if I don't want to continue?
q4.a: Since we operate on yearly plans, you can choose not to renew at the end of your subscription year — no penalty. We'll help you export your data within 30 days.

q5.a: We support FPX (online banking), credit/debit cards, DuitNow QR, e-wallets (Touch 'n Go, GrabPay, Boost), and Buy Now Pay Later — all via our payment partner Chip-in Asia.

q6.q: What if I run into an issue?
q6.a: Every plan includes WhatsApp support. Empayar and Franchise plans get priority support with faster response times. We also have a dedicated account manager for Franchise clients.

q7.q: What is the 2% platform fee for?
q7.a: Your 2% platform fee isn't just a fee — it funds marketing campaigns that bring customers to your door. We run targeted social media ads, seasonal promos (Raya, Merdeka, year-end), feature your store on the Singgah discovery platform, and provide campaign performance reports. Other platforms charge 30–35% commission and don't even market for you.

q8.q: I have many outlets — can I manage them all at once?
q8.a: Absolutely. Our Empayar plan supports up to 3 locations, and Franchise supports up to 10. All managed from a single Operations dashboard with cross-location analytics.

q9.a: Chupjer is fully SST compliant. You can configure tax settings per location, and all receipts and reports include proper SST breakdowns.
